claims.claim_ar: الجار والمجرور 'مِنْ فَوْقِهِمْ' متعلق بوصف موضع 'ظُلَلٌ' (ظرف مكان/جار ومجرور يبين موضع الظلال فوقهم)
claims.claim_en: 'min fawqihim' (مِنْ فَوْقِهِمْ) is a prepositional phrase attached to and qualifying 'ظُلَلٌ' — i.e. a locative/zarfi phrase indicating the place of the shades above them.
claims.needs_review_reason: The quoted source discusses the phrase 'من فوقهم' in a different verse (النحل:50) and comments on its locative/expressive force; the attachment here is extrapolated to this ayah rather than cited explicitly for it.

claims.claim_ar: الفعل 'يُخَوِّفُ' يدل على إحداث الخوف (خوف يخلف ضعف الخائف)؛ أي أن ما يُخَوِّفُ به الله عباده يترك أثر الخوف الذي يظهر ضعف المُخَوَّف أمام عظمة المسبب.
claims.claim_en: The verb 'yukhawwifu' (يُخَوِّفُ) denotes causing 'khawf' (fear), which, per the source, typically implies the weakness of the one who fears; thus 'that which Allah causes fear with' produces fear showing the fearer's weakness before the powerful cause.
claims.needs_review_reason: The source treats the semantic distinction between 'khawf' and 'khashyah' and general effects of 'fear'; it does not analyze this exact formulation in S39:16, so the semantic extrapolation to this ayah should be reviewed.

claims.claim_ar: إسناد 'مِنْ فَوْقِهِمْ' يحمل دلالة فوقية/عظمة؛ أي أن ذكر الظلال 'من فوقهم' يؤكد عظمة الجهة المذكورة ويُبيّن تضاد القوة والضعف بين المسبِّب والمخوف.
claims.claim_en: The phrase 'min fawqihim' carries a connotation of exaltation/greatness; stating 'shades from above them' emphasizes the greatness/loftiness of the position (and the contrast between the powerful source and the weak recipients).
claims.needs_review_reason: The source makes this semantic observation regarding 'من فوقهم' in a different verse (النحل:50); applying it to the locative phrase in S39:16 is plausible but should be checked against direct commentary on this ayah.
